entities.summary: Zakon i Pravosudiye is a Russian-language Kazakhstani newspaper based in Almaty. It specializes in law and politics of Kazakhstan and investigating and publicizing government corruption. Several of its journalists have disappeared in mysterious circumstances; among them are Oralgaisha Omarshanova and Tokbergen Abiyev.
